measurement.candidate_grammar: ordinary locator candidates matching ^R?\d+(?:\.\d+)+\b after source-role classification and table exclusion
measurement.rationale: ACI structural locators are chapter-qualified; chapter 0 is not a publication chapter, while decimal engineering expressions beginning with 0 repeatedly collide with the permissive locator grammar.

implemented_discriminator.rule: For ordinary Code/Commentary locator promotion, reject candidates whose chapter component is 0 before duplicate selection and structural-node construction.
implemented_discriminator.scope: ordinary locator promotion only; table recognition is unchanged

whole_document_replay.method: Run the PR #267 ACI page-adapter recognition rules across all 628 pages extracted with the repository PyMuPDF layout contract; aggregate source-safe locator and diagnostic counts without retaining protected prose.
